name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his family's garage. He pursued a degree in electrical engineering, specializing in high-performance systems. After graduating, he cut his teeth working for a local racing team, quickly establishing himself as a reliable and resourceful engineer. His experience landed him a role with Inter Europol Competition, where he's proven adept at diagnosing complex electrical issues and optimizing performance. 

Liam approaches his work with meticulous precision, constantly seeking ways to improve the car's electrical systems. He's known for his ability to remain calm under pressure, a crucial asset in the high-stakes environment of motorsport. Liam is particularly interested in the integration of renewable energy sources into motorsport applications, a passion that sets him apart from his peers.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even off the track.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee.
Has a habit of muttering technical jargon to himself when troubleshooting.
